sentences.en: In 2024, a mid-sized European city closed its historic centre to private cars.
sentences.zh: 2024 年，一座中等规模的欧洲城市将老城区对私家车关闭。

sentences.en: At first, shop owners feared that customers would stay away.
sentences.zh: 起初，店主们担心顾客会不再上门。

stay.zh: 停留（stay away 意为不来、远离）

sentences.en: Two years later, sales in the area have risen by almost a fifth.
sentences.zh: 两年后，该区域的销售额增长了近五分之一。

sentences.en: The city now plans to extend the ban to three more districts.
sentences.zh: 该市现在计划把禁令扩大到另外三个城区。

sentences.en: Not everyone is pleased, however; delivery drivers say their routes are longer and slower.
sentences.zh: 不过并非所有人都满意：送货司机说他们的路线更长也更慢。
